summary: A custom QX page (8,600px) for white-label back-office support to fractional CFO firms: a photo head with a quote form, a problem list, a four-step model, two comparison tables, three engagement cards, the shared difference grid, a dark CTA and a purple impact band, then FAQ with a side image and a closing CTA.

sections.note: full-bleed dark photo with a purple wash; left: white title, a two-line lead; right: a white 'request a quote' form card (name, email, company, phone, source, message, submit). No button besides the form.
centered coral tag, heading and line; five problems in two columns (round icon, bold title, a line) over a pale pink wash, then one coral button
pale blue: tag, heading; four steps in a row joined by a line, each a numbered circle, an icon, a bold title and two lines
tag, heading and line; a two-column table with a purple header row (capability, what it means) and five rows
heading and line; three white engagement-model cards, the middle one raised and outlined, each with a title, bullets and a button
centered heading and line; eight icon cards in 4 by 2 (shared across QX pages)
dark purple band with a photo and big pale number shape right and one coral button
tag, heading; a two-column table (what sets us apart / detail) with five rows
purple band: heading, five white cards (3 over 2), each with a round icon, a bold figure line and a caption
lilac band: a tall photo left, heading and six rows right, the first open
purple band: heading, one line and a coral button
